data.content_ref: inline:SRC_003's refutation clause says the function cannot be 'reduced to the identical 9 + 90 + 201 sum,' but the function D(n) = 9×1 + 90×2 + (n−99)×3 reduces to the digit counts 9, 180, 603 — not to the page-count sum 9 + 90 + 201. Conflating the page-count decomposition with the digit-count decomposition makes the stated refutation condition a non-sequitur: the formula is verified by digit totals, not by a 300-page total expressed as 9+90+201.
